/**
 * @name Unsafe eval usage in setuptools
 * @description Use of eval or exec with potentially untrusted configuration data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of eval or exec with potentially untrusted configuration data"
findings.hypothesis: Looking for eval or exec usage in setuptools codebase that could execute untrusted package configuration

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in setuptools
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Setuptools may use unsafe deserialization methods (pickle, yaml, marshal) that could lead to arbitrary code execution if untrusted data is processed
